I have measured BCR-ABL1 kinase IC50 and hERG IC50 assay data for 15 compounds. Ingest this data and produce a composite safety-potency ranking. Generate the workflow now.

compound_id,assay_type,valu…
turns.responseText:
BCR-ABL1 Campaign Safety-Potency Ranking — Ingests dual-assay IC50 data for 15 compounds and produces a composite rank ordered by kinase potency and cardiac safety margin.

Input: Inline assay CSV — 15 compounds × 2 assay types (IC50_BCR_ABL1 in nM, hERG_IC50 in µM), dated 2026-03-15
Key steps:

Assay ingestion & normalization (PKNCA / RDKit parser) → pivoted compound × assay matrix with unit harmonization (all values converted to µM)
Composite scorer → selectivity index (SI = hERG_IC50 ÷ BCR-ABL1_IC50) + percentile rank weighting (50% potency, 50% cardiac safety) → composite_score per compound
Ranked report generator → ranked_compounds.csv + HTML leaderboard + summary.json flagging hERG IC50 < 1 µM as cardiac risk (red) and BCR-ABL1 IC50 > 100 nM as low potency (amber)


Expected output: ranked_compounds.csv (rank, compound_id, BCR-ABL1 IC50, hERG IC50, SI, composite score, risk flag) + interactive HTML report + campaign_summary.json with top-3 and flagged compounds

Decision gate: hERG IC50 ≥ 1 µM AND BCR-ABL1 IC50 ≤ 10 nM required to pass cardiac safety + potency threshold — CPD009 (hERG 0.08 µM) and CPD010 (hERG 0.05 µM) are auto-flagged as withdrawn-drug analogues and will rank last regardless of potency score.

Input data files (e.g., structures/SMILES, assay data, or concentration-time table)
Basic study metadata (condition, units, and endpoint definitions)

turns.responseText:
CRO Submission Export — WuXi AppTec (BCR-ABL1 Campaign) — Validates cardiac safety and formats all 5 ranked compounds into a WuXi-ready CSV export.

Input: 5 compounds with SMILES, campaign ranking (Asciminib #1 → Gleevec-analog-1 #5), IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), and composite scores from the BCR-ABL1 campaign
Key steps:

hERG safety gate → flags any compound with hERG IC50 ≤ 1 μM as cardiac-unsafe and blocks it from export
RDKit MW/LogP computation + WuXi AppTec column formatter → standardizes compound_id, SMILES, IC50, hERG IC50, composite score, MW, and LogP into CRO-spec format
CSV export validator → confirms no withdrawn drugs, all 5 compounds pass cardiac threshold, and output file is WuXi-submission-ready


Expected output: wuxiapptec_submission.csv (5 compounds, ranked, with all required assay columns) + metadata JSON summarizing pass/fail status per compound

Decision gate: All 5 compounds must clear hERG IC50 > 1 μM — any compound failing this threshold is automatically excluded from the export CSV and flagged in the metadata JSON before submission.
